players.name: Gideon Davidson
players.notes: Corroborated by 2 independent public reports. Dabo Swinney said Davidson will miss at least this week after his injury against Florida State. A possible second missed week is not stored as a confirmed future absence.

players.name: Duce Robinson
players.notes: Corroborated by 2 independent public reports. Warchant confirmed a season-ending ACL tear following the Oct. 31 Clemson game; independent reporting also confirms the season-ending injury.

players.name: Ousmane Kromah
players.notes: Corroborated by 2 independent public reports. School announced season-ending surgery after the Miami game. Preserve the absence across the bye.

players.name: Mason Heintschel
players.notes: Corroborated by 2 independent public reports. Pittsburgh confirmed a season-ending knee injury following the Oct. 2 Virginia Tech game. Pat Narduzzi subsequently confirmed the quarterback replacement.

players.name: Julian Sayin
players.notes: Corroborated by 2 independent public reports. Ryan Day confirmed on Oct. 20 that Sayin is out indefinitely following the Oct. 17 injury. No return date was confirmed; this is not a confirmed season-ending designation. A newer verified return report supersedes this assertion.

players.name: Dante Moore
players.notes: Corroborated by 2 independent public reports. Dan Lanning said on Oct. 26 that Moore is not medically cleared and is not expected to play again this season. Scout-team participation does not establish game clearance.

players.name: Chase Sowell
players.notes: Corroborated by 2 independent public reports. Matt Campbell described Sowell as probable at the Nov. 3 press conference. This is the coach's Tuesday assessment, subject to the subsequent conference report.

players.name: Koby Howard
players.notes: Corroborated by 2 independent public reports. Matt Campbell said Howard remains uncertain while returning from an extended absence. The corroborating headline and Seattle context identify Washington; its stray Auburn reference is a source copy error and is not imported.

players.name: Kylan Fox
players.notes: Corroborated by 2 independent public reports. Season absence confirmed following fall-camp injury; not a weekly absence that should disappear during a bye.

players.name: Nico Iamaleava
players.notes: Corroborated by 2 independent public reports. Bob Chesney confirmed on Oct. 19 that Iamaleava will miss the rest of the season and requires knee surgery following the Oct. 10 injury.

players.name: Christian Moss
players.notes: Corroborated by 2 independent public reports. Latest team coverage reports a season absence; earlier coach coverage discussed seeking another year of eligibility.

players.name: Jordan Washington
players.notes: Corroborated by 2 independent public reports. Latest team coverage reports a season absence. Exact Washington RB identity; does not apply to North Carolina's same-name TE.

players.name: Tre Spivey
players.notes: Corroborated by 2 independent public reports. Brent Brennan confirmed on Oct. 5 that Spivey will miss the rest of the 2026 season and requires surgery for the foot injury suffered against Cincinnati.

players.name: LJ Martin
players.notes: Corroborated by 2 independent public reports. Kalani Sitake said on Nov. 2 that Martin will be evaluated over the next 48 hours after missing four games. A possible return is not a clearance; the previous OUT is not carried forward as a new official ruling.

players.name: Avery Johnson
players.notes: Corroborated by 2 independent public reports. Collin Klein described only an outside chance of a return and named Blake Barnett the starter. This is a bounded Week 10 doubtful designation, not a confirmed season-ending absence. Reports disagree on injury location, so no location is asserted.

players.name: Quincy Porter
players.notes: Corroborated by 2 independent public reports. Marcus Freeman confirmed season-ending surgery. Inclusion in the independent fantasy pool must also include injury coverage.

players.name: Ryan Coleman-Williams
players.notes: Corroborated by 2 independent public reports. Kalen DeBoer said Coleman-Williams is doing on-field work after missing two games, but did not confirm clearance for LSU. Practice progress is not represented as healthy or a guaranteed return.

players.name: KaMario Taylor
players.notes: Corroborated by 2 independent public reports. The program announced on Oct. 27 that Taylor will miss the remainder of the 2026 season. The subsequent surgery update corroborates the absence.

players.name: Ahmad Hardy
players.notes: Corroborated by 2 independent public reports. Missouri confirmed Hardy returned against Arkansas on Oct. 31. This clears the prior absence; it does not promise a full workload or establish a practice participation level.

players.name: Kewan Lacy
players.notes: Corroborated by 2 independent public reports. Pete Golding said on Nov. 2 that he is not expecting Lacy this week while Lacy continues rehabilitation. This is doubtful for Week 10 rather than a fabricated official OUT or season-ending ruling.

players.name: Jayden Sellers
players.notes: South Carolina Athletics announced a season-ending lower-body injury.
players.audit_note: Existing designation retained after source recheck; source fields above reflect the existing database record and are not fabricated.

players.name: Matt Fuller
players.notes: Corroborated by 2 independent public reports. Shane Beamer reported successful Nov. 1 surgery and at least a month of recovery. A possible postseason return means this is OUT for Week 10, not a confirmed season-ending designation. Recheck the next weekly report.
